sources.informs: history, dates 1603-1611 church, tower 1614, upper tower dark grey since 2017 restoration
east long side: window rhythm, aisle roof, dwarshuis gables, tower stages (identified as the SE side: tower stands at the left end)
tower from the south: stage widths, clock stage, onion dome, crown, vane
frontal c.1900 view: stage heights and widths measured in pixels against the 10.4 m cornice
stage 1/clock stage detail, corner columns, dials, balustrade
belfry arches, vases with gilt finials, octagonal balustrade

measured.tower: 9.5 m square shaft rotated 26.3 degrees, brick to 30.2 m (3DBAG flat top); stage 1 cream 30.8-38.5, clock stage 39.4-43.4, lead octagon 43.8-47.1, balustrade, belfry 48.5-55, onion dome 55.9, crown, needle; top about 66 m in the model. Photos give about 66-70 m; the 3DBAG lidar top (dome) is 60.5 m. A figure near 80 m is often quoted but is not supported by the photographs.
measured.stairTurret: 3DBAG walls show a 3.2 m stair turret on the north face of the shaft, to 30.2 m
measured.nave: 3DBAG ridge 24.6 m, aisle eaves about 10.4 m

limitations: east side photo shows about five window bays and a large pointed transept window; the 3DBAG shell yields four bays and no transept window (held as a limitation)
west side and north end have no reference photo (inferred)
in-game shot not representative: the running bundle still draws the old procedural kit until the integrator rebuilds bundles
